verdict.rationale: Zulip ships a comprehensive, machine-readable REST API (full OpenAPI spec, live documented endpoints, official CLI/bot frameworks) covering messaging, bots, integrations, and exports, suggesting broad API/UI parity. However, there's no direct evidence confirming full feature parity for every UI action (e.g., admin/org settings, topic management nuances), and llms.txt/docs-in-markdown probes 404'd, indicating some API discoverability gaps for AI agents.
